title: gymnocline armenum
intro: Gymnocline armenum, commonly known as Armenian cranesbill, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Geraniaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Armenian cranesbill are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which may also contribute to its antiseptic and wound-healing properties.
